name: Porsche Carrera GT RS
description: The Porsche Carrera GT RS is a fictional track-focused variant of the legendary Carrera GT (Project Code 980), a mid-engined supercar manufactured by Porsche between 2004 and 2007 in Leipzig, Germany. Sports Car International named the Carrera GT number one on its list of Top Sports Cars of the 2000s. This RS variant features an uprated 5.7-liter V10 engine producing 681 bhp at 8300 rpm and 636 Nm of torque, paired with a 6-speed manual transmission and rear-wheel drive. Weight has been reduced to 1340 kg through extensive use of lightweight materials. The ground effect body design generates significant downforce for high-speed stability, while a dry-sump oil system ensures reliable lubrication during extreme cornering. The minimalist interior features racing-type seats without power adjusters, aluminum and leather trim, and a color TFT instrument display.
